newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian c.bank sells HRK177 mln bills, rates flat.
newsitem.headline: Croatian c.bank sells HRK177 mln bills, rates flat.

text.p: Croatia's central bank sold 177 million kuna liquidity bills on Wednesday, up from just under 100 million at last week's auction.
The 35- and 91-day rates remained flat at 7.50 and 9.0 percent, respectively.
Commercial banks, which have access to auctions, again placed no bids for the central bank's longest maturity 182-day bills.

The bank said it planned no money market interventions this week, after draining back 94 million kuna on Tuesday it had injected in the banking system to help liquidity last Friday. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
